entries.label: Modern Predator
entries.prompt:
Create ONE isolated biomask in the exact same visible design and near-front camera as the attached RGB reference. This 256x257 screenshot of an unofficial community game-port HUD icon is the only authority for the visible design; do not claim canonical franchise accuracy. Make a source-bound PHG-quality game-prop render, preserving the original whole mask contour, width-to-height proportion, current yaw/pitch/roll, panel boundaries, apertures and recognizable source marks. Keep only the hard mask shell in the image: REMOVE all external hanging white/grey dreadlocks, hair strands, bands on those dreadlocks, wearer anatomy, neck, body and black background. Those bright peripheral strands belong to the wearer, NOT to the mask. Do not replace removed hair with new mask appendages or complete any hidden back or side geometry.

Improve rendering quality through coherent physical surfaces, soft neutral upper-left/front key light and restrained opposite frontal fill, controlled roughness differences, gentle metal reflections, dark cavity readability and restrained fine grain. Preserve the source's neutral grayscale: grey metal, silvery highlights, dark recesses. Do not invent bronze/gold, colored enamel, glowing color, blue tint or radioactive palette. Existing dark/light regions remain in their respective locations. Do not turn all materials into mirror chrome or a plastic toy. Resolve only source-visible broad construction; any tiny uncertain mark stays restrained. No newly invented horns, spikes, crests, runes, symbols, fasteners, vents, teeth, filigree or damage.

Output a single empty hard mask, no interior face/iris/flesh and no extra object, on native true transparent alpha. Same source camera, not a redesigned frontal or side view. Center the entire mask with 8–12 percent clear native margins on all sides and no clipped tips, object around78 percent of the longest canvas axis. Native high-resolution square PNG. No backdrop, cast floor shadow, black rectangle, halo, fake checkerboard, label, text, border, watermark or duplicate mask.

DESIGN LOCK: The mask itself has a wide smooth softly rounded crown with shallow twin upper lobes, nested arched/teardrop panels tapering toward the nose, and the two small source-visible round features on the center line of these arches. Preserve their locations and the visibly existing short source lines only. The angular eye inserts are light silver with fine dark diagonal slots; preserve this optical/grille treatment without adding colored glow or biological eyes. Keep the short squared central lower shield with its few slender vertical recessed marks, pronounced angular cheek edges and source-visible lateral hard panels. The lower shell is squared off as in the source, not an elongated pointed chin. Exclude every long pale strand below and beside it.
